implementation.summary: New library-convention-only module. Every contract, resource and PURE PARSER in commonMain - the placement that makes the feature testable with no phone. DeviceId/AvdName are private-constructor value classes with validating of(); DeviceCommand and HostCommand are closed sealed sets; buildDeviceArgv is the single [tool,-s,id,...] construction point. Four mechanisms together enforce NFR-5 by type rather than by call-site discipline.

troubleshooting.issue: Plan text said every tool probes $SDK/platform-tools/<bin>, but the emulator binary lives in <sdk>/emulator.
troubleshooting.resolution: Modelled as ToolKind.sdkSubdirectory and pinned by two tests.

troubleshooting.issue: Plan listed buildHostArgv with no host command type.
troubleshooting.resolution: Added a closed HostCommand sealed interface so 'device-less commands never emit -s' is enumerable and testable per variant.
